summary: GE Aerospace filed an 8-K reporting two board-level governance actions dated September 21, 2026. The independent directors appointed Wesley Bush as independent Lead Director, succeeding Tom Horton, who remains on the board; separately, director Judson Althoff, elected effective June 24, 2026, was appointed to the Audit Committee. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, or advisors were disclosed. Both changes are effective immediately and filer-confirmed via press release exhibit. Watch for further board refreshment or committee realignment as routine succession, not a control event.
